title: LP5907-3.3 model against its datasheet
covers: the model of the 3.3 V regulators U7 and U8
summary: A regulator of the schematic is put, alone, into the test circuits of its datasheet. The start from the enable pin and the discharge of the output, the load regulation and the current limit, the dropout at 100 mA and at 250 mA, the thresholds of the enable pin, and the supply rejection from 100 Hz to 100 kHz.

notes: The fit this project asks of the model is 15 % on a typical value, and 3 dB on the supply rejection; where the datasheet states limits, the limits are the ones of the datasheet.
The model follows the supply rejection up to 100 kHz only, and it has no response of its own to a load step: the 40 mV of the datasheet for 250 mA are not in it.
The supply rejection is a small-signal analysis around an operating point that the solver finds with the regulator on.
